If a TCP-based socket connection has been lost (i.e. Socket con- nection is other than SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE), the Service Discovery Module shall call: • SoAd_ReleaseRemoteAddr() • SoAd_DisableSpecificRouting() • SoAd_CloseSoCon() • delete all internally stored subscriptions belonging to that connection. • SoAd_OpenSoCon() The Service Discovery Module shall stay in the Main Phase.
